alternatives: Keep release evidence only in pull-request prose or workflow logs
Publish the release before independently reproducing every promotion claim
decisions.choice: Retain a versioned release-evidence document that binds every promotion gate to exact source, workflow, artifact, and verifier identities.
decisions.rationale: A repository record is reviewable and durable, while exact immutable identities let an independent verifier reproduce claims without trusting the author or mutable branch state.

alternatives: Treat documentation checks as advisory after publishing
Allow a maintainer assertion to substitute for missing release evidence
decisions.choice: Fail closed before release publication when any recorded identity, digest, gate result, or retained artifact cannot be independently reproduced.
decisions.rationale: A release evidence record is useful only when absence, ambiguity, and mismatch block promotion rather than becoming accepted exceptions.

acceptance_criteria.failure_behavior: Any missing gate, unresolved identifier, or irreproducible result denies release publication.
acceptance_criteria.observable: The versioned document records all required promotion gates and binds them to exact source commits, workflow runs, retained artifacts, checksums, and verifier identities.

acceptance_criteria.failure_behavior: Any accepted stale, mutable, unsigned, self-asserted, or mismatched reference denies release publication.
acceptance_criteria.observable: A deliberately stale commit, mutable branch reference, mismatched checksum, missing artifact, or unverified identity is rejected and cannot be reported as a passing promotion gate.

acceptance_criteria.failure_behavior: Any unresolved counterexample, unavailable retained input, or absent independent challenge denies release publication.
acceptance_criteria.observable: An independent challenger reproduces each material provenance and integrity assertion from immutable GitHub state and retained artifact bytes without relying on author claims.

acceptance_criteria.failure_behavior: If the prior verified state cannot be restored without publishing ambiguous evidence, the release remains quarantined.
acceptance_criteria.observable: When a claim fails verification, publication remains blocked, the candidate is quarantined, and the last verified release state is preserved without rewriting retained evidence.

outcome_metrics.observable: Percentage of sampled release-evidence assertions reproduced successfully from immutable source state and retained artifacts.
outcome_metrics.source: Independent release verifier observations over exact commits, workflow runs, checksums, attestations, and retained artifact bytes

failure_modes.condition: A recorded source commit, workflow run, checksum, attestation, reviewer identity, or artifact differs from independently observed immutable state.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: The conflicting assertion is reported as non-passing, the candidate remains quarantined, and release publication is denied.
failure_modes.rollback_trigger: Any material identity or integrity mismatch triggers quarantine and restoration of the last verified release state.

failure_modes.condition: Required evidence is missing, expired, inaccessible, produced only by the candidate, or expressed through a mutable reference.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: The corresponding gate remains non-passing and neither prose nor maintainer confidence can substitute for independently reproducible evidence.
failure_modes.rollback_trigger: Missing independently reproducible evidence prevents publication and preserves the previously verified state.

goals: Make every v1.0.0 promotion decision independently reproducible from immutable identities and retained bytes
Prevent stale, mutable, missing, self-asserted, or mismatched release evidence from being reported as passing
Keep candidate quarantine and restoration behavior explicit when verification fails

invariants.statement: No promotion gate is marked passing unless its material assertions reproduce from independently administered or trusted execution evidence.
A failed or ambiguous candidate never replaces, rewrites, or weakens the last verified release state.

non_goals: Changing runtime code, policy thresholds, branch protection, or release workflow behavior
Treating this design record, pull-request prose, author assertions, or model output as admission evidence
Publishing the repository, changing account settings, or creating the final v1.0.0 release

signals.decision_use: Deny publication unless every required gate has an exact independently reproducible evidence reference.
signals.name: Reproducible release gate coverage

signals.decision_use: Quarantine the candidate immediately when any expected and observed immutable identity or digest differ.
signals.name: Release identity and digest mismatches

problem: The v1.0.0 candidate has extensive verification evidence, but promotion requires a durable, independently reviewable record that binds every release claim to immutable identities and fails closed on mismatch or absence.

rollback.strategy: Keep the candidate unpublished and quarantined, preserve the last verified release state, and correct inaccurate documentation only through a new governed change that retains the original evidence history.
triggers: Any required gate lacks an independently reproducible source
Any recorded identity, checksum, attestation, workflow result, or retained artifact fails comparison
An independent challenger produces an unresolved counterexample

title: Retain independently reproducible v1.0.0 release evidence

controls: Read source and workflow state by immutable identifiers
Recompute checksums from retained artifact bytes
Verify attestations against the exact repository, workflow, subject, and signer
Require independent challenge and deny promotion on missing or conflicting evidence
trust_boundaries.data: Source commits, workflow run identities, gate results, artifact bytes, checksums, attestations, reviewer identities, and release status
